description: This file defines an Android activity 'FragmentArguments' demonstrating fragment configuration via bundle arguments and layout attributes, including an inner class 'MyFragment' that manages fragment lifecycle and view creation.

classes.name: FragmentArguments
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating fragment configuration via arguments and layout attributes.

classes.name: MyFragment
classes.description: A fragment class that initializes with arguments and inflates a view with a label.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and adds the fragment if first creation.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of MyFragment with a label argument.

methods.name: onInflate
methods.description: Parses layout attributes during inflation to set the label.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets the label from arguments if available.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates and returns the fragment's view, setting the label text.
